audios.title: A radio interview with a travel writer
audios.instructions: Listen to the interview and choose the correct answer A, B, C or D.
audios.transcript: Welcome to the show, Emma. You have just published a book about travelling alone. That is right. So, what is the biggest challenge of travelling alone? I think it is the loneliness. You can be in the most beautiful place in the world, but if you have no one to share it with, it can feel empty. But there must be advantages too. Absolutely. You have complete freedom. You can change your plans at any moment, stay longer somewhere you like or leave a place you don't like. What advice would you give to someone who wants to try it? Start with a short trip. Do not go to the other side of the world for your first solo adventure. Try a weekend in a nearby city, then build up from there.

audios.instructions: Listen to the conversation and choose the correct answer A, B, C or D.
audios.transcript: So, how is your new life in Manchester? To be honest, it is harder than I expected. Really? What is the problem? Well, I love my job and the city is fantastic, but I don't know anyone here. I spend most of my evenings alone. Have you tried joining a club or a sports team? Not yet. I think I should. That is how I met most of my friends when I moved here. I joined a running club and it changed everything. That is a great idea. I have also thought about taking a cooking class. Do it. You will meet people with similar interests. You are right. I will look for something this weekend.

audios.title: A conversation about healthy eating
audios.instructions: Listen to the conversation and choose the correct answer A, B, C or D.
audios.transcript: You look great! Have you been doing something different? Thanks. I changed my diet about three months ago. Really? What did you change? Well, I used to eat a lot of processed food - pizzas, burgers, that kind of thing. Now I cook most of my meals at home. I also eat more vegetables and fruit. Do you miss fast food? Sometimes, especially when I am tired or stressed. But the benefits are worth it. I have more energy and I sleep better. That is amazing. I should try it. How did you start? I started small. I just changed one meal a day. Then, after a few weeks, I changed another. It is easier when you do it gradually.

audios.instructions: Listen to the conversation and choose the correct answer A, B, C or D.
audios.transcript: How is your Italian going? Honestly, it is difficult. I have been studying for six months but I still cannot have a proper conversation. That is normal. Learning a language takes time. What do you find most difficult? I think listening. When Italians speak fast, I cannot understand anything. Have you tried watching Italian films with subtitles? Yes, I do that. It helps a bit. What about speaking? Do you have anyone to practise with? Not really. That is probably the problem. I should find a language partner. You could try an app. There are apps where you can chat with native speakers. That is a good idea. I will download one tonight.
